state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports mixed weak-to-strong results on chess puzzles: with the smallest weak models PGR is close to zero and test accuracy curves appear flat, PGR rises substantially as supervisor size increases and can exceed 40% for small supervisor-student gaps, and unlike the NLP setting PGR decreases with strong student size for a given weak supervisor.
title: Weak-to-strong on chess: PGR near zero for weakest supervisors, falls with student size
